name: 04-add-assistant-prefix-tools-arg-nonempty
description: The other half of the `hasAnyTools` disjunction at prompt-converters.js:71: `Array.isArray(tools) && tools.length > 0`. Here no message has role `tool`, so the only thing suppressing the flag is the `tools` argument itself -- fixture 03b covers the message-role route and 03 covers the no-tools case, so between the three every arm of that boolean is pinned. `tools` is a non-empty array of definitions whose contents are never read; only its length matters, which is why they are placeholders.
